overlap.source: Reused from the project's earlier root-cause analysis (results_analysis/evaluation/scripts/analyze_switch_reasons.py, `max_box_overlap > 0.25` = occlusion trigger), which computed the same quantity: max IoU between the GT raider box and any other GT box.

speed.source: Reused from analyze_switch_reasons.py (`velocity > 35.0` px/frame, GT box-centre displacement between consecutive frames), converted to px/s at a nominal 30 fps (35 x 30 = 1050 px/s) so the threshold is a fixed physical-time rate. At the actual case FPS (24.0-30.9) this equals 34.0-43.8 px/frame.
speed.max_gap_note: Velocity is only computed between GT raider observations at most this many frames apart. 1 = strictly consecutive frames; no interpolation across gaps.
speed.difference_scheme: forward difference c[t+1]-c[t]; backward difference c[t]-c[t-1] only when t+1 is unavailable (flagged SPEED_BACKWARD_DIFFERENCE)
speed.box_shape_change_note: Flag (not relabel) when raider box area changes by more than this fraction between the two frames used: centre displacement then partly reflects box deformation (limb extension, crouch), not body translation. 0.5 matches the earlier project's 50% bbox-expansion rule.

depth.convention: MiDaS outputs relative INVERSE depth (disparity-like): larger value = closer to camera. Verified empirically per frame (see convention checks).
depth.statistic: median of MiDaS values over each player's box pixels, EXCLUDING the pixels in the raider/opponent box intersection (those pixels belong to whichever player is in front and would bias both medians toward each other)
depth.normalisation: difference divided by the frame's robust depth range (p95 - p5 of the full depth map), because MiDaS scale is arbitrary per frame
depth.margin_source: PROPOSED, not previously established in the repository. |normalised difference| <= margin -> UNKNOWN. Sensitivity at 0.02 and 0.10 is reported in classification_summary.md.
depth.valid_pixel_note: If fewer than max(min_valid_pixels, fraction x box area) exclusive pixels remain for either player, the label is UNKNOWN.
depth.opponent_selection: the opponent with the greatest GT box IoU (> 0). If no box overlaps, the nearest opponent by centre distance, if within proximity_max_raider_heights x raider box height; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.

duplicate_raider.rule: When >1 GT box is labelled raider, pick the one with greatest IoU to the previous selected raider box (same rule as generate_gt_tool_cases.py).
duplicate_raider.note: If the best continuity IoU < min_continuity_iou or beats the runner-up by less than min_continuity_margin, the raider is ambiguous and the frame is INELIGIBLE.
